Home / FAQs

Frequently asked questions.

Answers reflect how Flourrish works today. Where something depends on your management plan, the answer says so.

What does property management include?

It depends on the plan, but the core is scheduled inspections with photographic reports, maintenance coordination with your approval before work starts, tenant and rent coordination if the property is let, liaison with the society or association, and regular updates to you. Each service page lists what is included and what is not.

Can Flourrish manage my property if I live abroad?

Yes. Most owners we work with are outside Chennai, many outside India. Reports, quotations and approvals move over WhatsApp and email; visits and vendor supervision happen in Chennai. Communication windows are planned around your time zone where practical.

Which Indian cities and localities are covered?

Chennai only, at present. The current localities are listed on the Areas We Serve page. We do not manage property outside India, and overseas locations on this site refer to where owners live, not where properties are managed.

Do you manage apartments, villas and independent houses?

Yes: apartments and flats, villas and independent houses, let properties, small commercial units and vacant properties. Plots and land can be discussed case by case.

Can you manage vacant properties?

Yes. Vacant Property Care covers scheduled visits, ventilation, cleaning, lock and utility checks, bill and society-dues reminders, and readiness before a tenant or a family visit.

How are property inspections documented?

Each visit produces a dated report with photographs of each area, meter readings, observations and a recommended action for every item found. Reports follow the same checklist each time so you can compare visits.

How are maintenance costs approved?

For non-emergency work you receive the issue, the vendor quotation and the expected cost before anything starts, and work proceeds only on your approval. Emergency handling and any spending limit are written into your plan.

Do you find and coordinate tenants?

We handle enquiries and viewings for a listing, coordinate reference checks through channels you approve, and manage move-in, the tenancy and move-out. The decision on a tenant is yours. The rental agreement is prepared by a lawyer of your choice.

How are rent follow-ups handled?

Rent is paid to your account. We confirm receipt, run an agreed reminder sequence if it is late, and send a monthly status note. Rent is not guaranteed; defaults are escalated to you with the record of communication.

How often will I receive updates?

After every inspection and every completed job, plus a periodic summary. The schedule and channel are set in your plan. Urgent matters are raised as they happen.

How are management fees calculated?

Fees depend on the property type, location, occupancy, inspection frequency, maintenance coordination needed and reporting requirements. You receive a written proposal with the fee, billing schedule and GST before deciding. See the Management Proposal page.

What happens during an urgent repair?

The plan defines what counts as an emergency and what we may do immediately, up to what amount. Without an agreed limit, we contact you before spending. Either way you receive photographs and the bill afterwards.

How do I get started?

Send the enquiry form or a WhatsApp message with the property type, location, occupancy and what you need. We reply with questions, arrange a call, and send a written proposal if it fits.

Which services are outside the management agreement?

Legal representation, tax advice, property valuation, structural certification and regulated financial services. Vendor charges for repairs and improvements are separate from the management fee. Anything else outside the plan is quoted separately before it is done.

Do I need to give you power of attorney?

No. Routine management does not need it. If a specific transaction ever does, that is arranged between you and your lawyer.

Who holds the keys to my property?

Agreed at onboarding and recorded in writing: keys held by us, a keybox at the property, or a person you nominate.
